title: Duel Decks: Elspeth vs. Kiora: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression." —Gideon Jura
"The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail." —Cymede, queen of Akros
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?" —Polyxene the Doubter
Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.
"Our death-arrows flew in high arcs towards the aven. And then . . . nothing." —Coliseum guard
Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.
They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.
"If a boggart even dares breathe near one of my kin, I'll know. And I'll not be happy."
"Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."
"On every plane I've encountered loxodons, I've found stalwart and loyal friends." —Elspeth
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly." —Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard
"Such deeds should be common fare for such as us." —Anax, king of Akros
She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.
"In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."
Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.
"I was called to this world of steel, and it will be my steel that answers." —Elspeth
"Bant sentries were called the Angel Line. They never faltered, and they were ready to die defending their position." —Elspeth
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power." —Orim, Samite inquisitor
"Courage is a proud and gleaming shield. It does not bend or hide from sight. To fight with courage, we must forge in steel."
"Truth is a straight, keen edge. There are no soft angles or rounded edges. To fight for truth, we must forge in steel."
"Learn not only from the failures of the past, but also from its triumphs." —Isperia
"You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains." —Esper fable
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.
"Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."
Surrakar grab things they *don't* want.
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa." —Kiora
"I will never run out of new oceans to explore or new sea-dwellers to embrace as my own." —Kiora
Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago." —Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist
It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.
It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.
"Nature was slowly heading in the right direction, but we know how to achieve faster results." —Vorel of the Hull Clade
"She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales." —Ranalus, vedalken heretic
The Simic soon discovered that the sky offered as few constraints on size as the sea.
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you." —Vorel of the Hull Clade
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design." —Momir Vig
As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.
Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas." —Kiora
